_comment: Hand-curated venue aliases, merged into extension/venue-tiers.js by
build_venue_tiers.py alongside whatever venue_aliases holds in TicketPortal.
They live here rather than in the generated file so regenerating never drops them.
Keys are FIFA's tournament venue names (sponsor-free, as they appear on
tickets.fifa.com); values are the canonical key, normally the sponsored name
marketplaces use. Both sides are lowercased and whitespace-collapsed to match
UNVERIFIED: seeded by hand, not scraped from either site. Confirm each against
a real event page's venue string. A wrong alias silently splits one stadium
into two keys; a missing one just means the heuristic runs, which is harmless.
Entries whose canonical name is confirmed against a live page should be moved
